dialogue.text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. I'm here to look into your knee swelling; could you tell me when this started and if you recall any specific injury to the area?
My mommy noticed my knee was big and puffy after we played at the park yesterday. I didn't fall down or get a boo-boo, it just started swelling up on its own.
I see. Is the knee painful to move, and do you know if anyone else in your family has trouble with bleeding or joint swelling like this?
It hurts a little bit when I try to crawl or walk on it. My mommy says my Great Uncle had "bad knees" and boo-boos that wouldn't stop bleeding, too.

Has your knee ever swollen like this before, and have you noticed any large or unusual bruises on your body lately? 

REQUEST TEST: Coagulation_Screen_(PT/aPTT)
RESULTS: PT: 14.0 s, aPTT (ACT): 52.0 s (prolonged)

It's concerning that your aPTT is prolonged while your PT is normal. Have you ever had a nosebleed that was hard to stop or any bleeding from your gums?

REQUEST TEST: Factor_VIII_Activity_Level
REQUEST TEST: Factor_IX_Activity_Level
RESULTS: NORMAL READINGS

I have some purple spots on my tummy and legs that don't go away. Mommy says I get bruises really easily, even when I'm just playing gently with my toys.

I understand. Do those purple spots ever feel bumpy, or are they flat against your skin like a drawing?

Mommy is worried because she says my blood takes a long time to turn into a scab when I get a scratch. Do you think you can help make my knee feel better so I can go back to the park? I hope I don't need any more pokes today.
I will do my best to make your knee feel better quickly. Since your tests for the most common factors were normal but your clotting time is still long, I need to check one
I hope the next test helps you find the answer. Is it because of the same thing my Great Uncle had? My knee feels very tight and it's hard to bend it right now.
It is very possible this is related to your Great Uncle's condition, as these things can run in families. To be sure, I need to check one more factor in your blood
Okay, I understand. Does that mean my blood is missing one of the pieces it needs to stay strong? I just want the tightness in my knee to go away so I can play with my trucks again.
Yes, it sounds like your blood is missing a "puzzle piece" that helps it stay strong and stop bleeding. I'm going to run one more test to see if that missing piece is Factor

Is Factor IX the name of the puzzle piece you are looking for? Mommy said the doctor told my uncle he had the "B" kind of the bleeding sickness. I hope you find the piece soon so my knee stops feeling so big and heavy.
Actually, we already checked Factor IX, and it came back normal, which means it might not be the same kind as your uncle's. I'm going to check Factor XII and Factor X

I'm confused because I thought I had the same thing as my uncle, but I just want my knee to stop hurting. Does it matter which number is missing as long as you can fix it? I'm getting tired of waiting and I really want to go home.
It matters very much because the right treatment depends on knowing exactly which piece is missing to keep you safe. I am going to test for Factor XIII and a few others to solve this

Will the test for number thirteen tell you why my knee is so puffy? I'm sorry I'm being fussy, I just want the heavy feeling to go away. Please help me get better so I don't get any more purple spots.
Yes, testing for Factor XIII can help us understand why your blood isn't forming strong scabs. Have you noticed if your wounds ever start bleeding again after they seemed to have stopped

Sometimes when I get a scrape, it stops for a little while but then the red juice starts coming out again the next day. It's like the scab isn't very strong and just falls right off. Does that mean the Factor Thirteen piece is what makes the scabs stay stuck?
That is exactly what Factor XIII does; it acts like a strong glue to keep the scab in place. Since your other tests didn't find the missing piece, I'm going to check

That sounds like the glue I need! Does that mean if you give me some of that Factor Thirteen glue, my knee will stop being so big and the purple spots will go away? I hope this is the last test so we can fix my "bad knees" like my uncle had.

If this test confirms it, we can start the right treatment to help your knee and stop the bruising. I am going to run one last check to be absolutely sure.
